household_key_source: Orion clientId, read from the fact_positions holdings surface (the identity surface carries the same value). It is present on all 980 accounts, never null and never zero, and Orion transactions householdId carries the same value on all 871 accounts that have both, so it is one household key. householdName is a name and is not used as a key, and the custodian account number is never a key. A missing key writes household_id null with the reason NO_RELATIONSHIP_SENTINEL; the dry run had none. The key is shared by several accounts: 320 distinct keys across 980 accounts.
coverage_words: Until its tax lots and transaction history are shown, an Inflection account carries full identity and holdings coverage only, because the custody holdings and the identity surface agree on every account, and its lot-level figures read as no lots until DB-b-212 shows Eclipse tax lots populated.
